title: Sow: an exceptional guide
text: I did the complete tour of the Alhambra and the Generalife gardens, as well as the visit to the cathedral of Granada, the historic center, and Sacromonte. Sow is a FANTASTIC guide; he is very knowledgeable and provides very clear and comprehensive explanations, along with many historical references. Sow completely adapts to you. He gives you advice on what other visits to make. I RECOMMEND SOW WITHOUT ANY HESITATION. Nathalie
author: X7284UVnathalies

title: Guided tour with Sow
text:
We met Sow to accompany us through all the corners of the Alhambra.
A visit full of details and legends, with Sow, a wonderful guide who manages to convey his passion for the history of Granada.
Sow is very attentive, answers all our questions with the patience of an angel, does not count his time, and moves at our pace (Andalusian pace!)
A very beautiful encounter in Granada 
We wish him the best for the future, and we will recommend him to our friends!
Cecilia
author: Resort00127121104

title: Mouna
text: We had a wonderful 3.5-hour tour of the Alhambra, and our guide was outstanding. He was extremely knowledgeable, patient, and passionate about the history and beauty of this incredible place. He took the time to answer all our questions and made sure everyone in the group felt comfortable and engaged throughout the visit. His explanations were clear, interesting, and brought the history of the Alhambra to life. Thanks to him, our experience was truly memorable. I highly recommend this tour and especially this guide to anyone visiting the Alhambra.
author: Mounad62

title: Guided tour in French to choose without hesitation!
text: We discovered L Alhambra with Sow, a guide, punctual, generous, very cultured, filled with joy and good humor! He gave us lots of historical facts, told us when it came to legend and showed us the evidence of the historical facts told today. He has a very good command of Arabic calligraphy with a good accent, which puts even more in context. He also answered our questions about life in Granada today! Not being good at understanding English or Spanish, this visit in French was perfect for us! We recommend it!
author: Getaway68568476945
